title: Local structure at the maximum and sharp persistence asymptotics of rough fractional Brownian motion
summary: We consider a fractional Brownian motion $B$ with Hurst index $0<H<1/2$, and its maximiser $τ$ on $[0,1]$. We show that the rescaled process $a^H(B_{τ+\,\cdot\,/a}-B_τ)$ converges in $C_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb R)$ to a limiting tangent law that is $H$-self-similar, supported on nonpositive paths pinned at zero, and rerooting-rescaling invariant: rerooting the limit process at its maximum on any fixed compact interval separated from zero and rescaling again asymptotically reproduces the same law.
